What is ScriptCraft and what is it like to use?

Long image

A

Answer

ScriptCraft is a free, open-source screenwriting app for people who write films, TV and plays. You type, and Enter and Tab pick the screenplay format for you. It lays out standard script pages, saves Final Draft or Fountain files and exports PDF. It is working software, not a plan.

  1. It follows the Final Draft way of typing: Enter after a scene heading gives Action, Tab gives a Character, Enter after a Character gives Dialogue.1
  2. Pages use the US industry layout: Letter, 12-point Courier, (MORE) and (CONT'D) when dialogue breaks across pages.2
  3. It opens and saves .fdx and .fountain files and exports PDF, so a script can move to and from other tools.2
  4. Its own checklist counts 62 of 68 Final Draft 13 features as implemented; 6 are not done yet.3

Applies toScriptCraft at commit d7f6b76 (v0.4 done)desktop app on macOS, Windows, Linux, plus a browser buildFinal Draft behaviour taken from public documentation, not checked against Final Draft 13 yet

1

What does a writer do, step by step?

Diagram structure
  • Open or start a script open
  • Type with Enter and Tab type
  • See real pages pages
  • Rearrange scenes organize
  • Check reports reports
  • Save or export save
  • open → type
  • organize → reports
  • pages → organize
  • reports → save
  • type → pages · formats
  1. Open or start a script ↗

    Start blank, from a template (feature, TV single-camera, multi-camera, stage play), or open an existing .fdx or .fountain file. The app ships with an original sample, Night Signal.

  2. Type with Enter and Tab ↗

    Type int. diner - night, press Enter for Action, Tab for a Character, Enter for Dialogue. Headings and names capitalise themselves; SmartType offers names and locations already used.

  3. See real pages ↗

    The page view shows Letter pages in Courier with page numbers, (MORE) and (CONT'D). The status bar shows the element, page, scene and word count.

  4. Rearrange scenes ↗

    The Navigator lists scenes; index cards hold a summary per scene and can be dragged to reorder; an Outline view, story map and beat board help plan structure.

  5. Check reports ↗

    Character, scene and location reports come from the same pagination as the PDF.

  6. Save or export ↗

    Save as Final Draft (.fdx) or Fountain, or export a PDF with embedded Courier Prime. Autosave and backups keep work safe.

What does it look like?

4

What goes in, and what comes out?

Goes inComes out
Files.fdx (Final Draft XML) or .fountain.fdx, .fountain, PDF
WritingYour typing, keys and menu choicesFormatted pages with scene numbers and a title page
PlanningScene summaries, colours, tags, beatsNavigator, index cards, outline, story map
NumbersThe script itselfReports: speeches and words per character, scene lengths in eighths, locations
ProductionRevision mode, locked pages, tagsColoured revision pages, A/B pages, breakdown reports

For the sample Night Signal, scriptcraft-cli report prints 4 pages, 4 scenes and 699 words; NELL has 12 speeches.4

How finished is it?

Stage
v0.4 (structure and collaboration) done; v0.2 and v0.3 done
Final Draft 13 checklist
62 implemented · 0 partial · 6 not yet (of 68)
Runs on
macOS, Windows, Linux (desktop) and in a browser (WebAssembly)
Licence
MIT OR Apache-2.0; clean-room, no Final Draft code or assets

Not done yet

Not yet built: a thesaurus and a Format Assistant, among the 6 open checklist items.3 Open follow-ups include printing directly to a printer and some report and dual-dialogue edge cases.5 Mapping revisions, locks and tags to Final Draft's own FDX, and importing from Word, Celtx and PDF, are still on the roadmap. The typing flow follows Final Draft's public conventions; it has not been checked against Final Draft 13 itself.1

6

Who else can drive it?

Every action is a command with an id, and the same commands drive the menus, keyboard, a command-line tool, a JSON control channel and an MCP server. The CLI lists 185 engine commands. So a script, a test or an AI agent can write, convert and report on screenplays without the window.2
